decisions.reason: Because it builds on established spraying systems and early results are still uncertain, organizational slack supports keeping it while monitoring against aspirations.
Close to the established portfolio with its own web page, its results likely meet aspirations, making a drop unlikely.
Though a multi-model line with only basic web presence creates some uncertainty, slack and its established base justify keeping it under review.
With dedicated web presence and built on existing capabilities, its performance is likely acceptable and slack supports continued evaluation.
